caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jug placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The jug is cylindrical with a broad, round opening at the top and a slightly tapering base. It features two small, rounded handles on either side near the top. The jug is predominantly a muted gray-tan color with a matte texture, and on its front, there are hand-painted blue floral motifs consisting of leaves and blossoms. Above the decoration, there are embossed or inscribed words, partially visible, and the top inner edge of the jug has a brownish tint. The artist’s name, “Geo. Lougeridge,” is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
